purpose: Measure whether hybrid distillation and conditional computation improve independent identification quality, efficiency or both.

gates.confirmation: Frozen untouched identities and scaffolds, upstream exposure checked. Reused/leaky DEV cannot authorize promotion. Insufficient precision means inconclusive. Familywise adaptive exploration remains exploratory until one frozen confirmation.

experiments.name: Herstel en bevries de vergelijkingsbasis
experiments.fixed_design: Remove truth-row-derived catalogue metadata from novel tracks; do not remove hard queries. Keep recognition, new identities and new scaffolds separate. Validate all upstream training and checkpoint selection exposures.
experiments.platform: Kaggle CPU checks; Colab for GPU checkpoint parity

experiments.name: Neurale student vervangt LambdaRank
experiments.fixed_design: Twofold identity-excluded teacher targets on TRAIN; fixed 8 epochs. Freeze trained student before confirmation. No teacher predictions on its own training identities. Same candidate/features initially; report feature costs separately.
experiments.platform: Colab T4 training; Kaggle offline functional parity

experiments.name: Vaste teacher-studentcombinatie
arms: fixed .8 baseline + .2 student after declared normalization
experiments.fixed_design: No blend-weight search after DEV results. Report discordant wins/losses and residual covariance on fixed context strata, not score correlation alone.

experiments.name: Goedkope route met specialist op aanvraag
experiments.fixed_design: Fit and calibrate on separate TRAIN/calibration identities. Router sees only features computed before route selection. Choose one threshold on calibration against preregistered quality/cost loss, then lock. Compare actual cold/warm p50/p95 and candidate-generation costs.
experiments.platform: Colab T4 development and repeated same-device latency; Kaggle end-to-end offline

experiments.name: Compact spectrum-CNN als student
arms: same frozen target features through MLP
fixed small 1D CNN on documented m/z bins with precursor/adduct channels
experiments.fixed_design: Two architecture arms only. No CNN over arbitrarily ordered feature columns. Use genuine energy-indexed sequence branch only if measured ordered energies exist; otherwise no RNN claim. Keep acquisition preprocessing and all identities fixed.
experiments.platform: Colab T4; fixed training-time budget before run
experiments.primary: quality and cost vs MLP; fingerprintRMSE only if fingerprint head trained

experiments.name: CASMI2022 met en zonder LLM
arms: same candidate set + frozen offline LLM reranker
experiments.fixed_design: Priority/bonus separate; exclude81/282/432/476; historical first-block top1 primary. No answer keys/challengeIDs/names in inference. Audit identity/spectral/LLM exposure; same candidate set and tool budget. Fixed prompt/checkpoint/decoding, invalid output fallback. Both all-valid and joint-attempted denominators.
experiments.platform: Colab T4 exclusively for historical GPU runs
experiments.primary: paired top1 and historical task score; MRR25 supplementary
experiments.submission: historical benchmark artifact only; no Kaggle2026 slot

experiments.name: Echte aanvulling met voorwaartse fragmentatie
arms: B plus one approved forward channel or LLM chemical feature
experiments.fixed_design: Select at most one source/checkpoint before confirmation using clean development data. Same candidates; enforce elemental/mass checks; cap per-query expensive budget. No hosted API in offline rerun; no unknown-source teacher output silently treated as allowed data.
experiments.primary: quality gate; report corrected and damaged predictions
experiments.submission: S-D alternative to HX04, not another confirmation peek

submissions.claim: Student can preserve quality with lower end-to-end cost; leaderboard alone does not measure speed.
submissions.required: efficiency confirmation, complete offline parity and valid 400-query output
submissions.prediction: freeze directional expectation, uncertainty rationale and exact artifact before submission; no numerical forecast invented from biased DEV

submissions.claim: Neural complement adds rank quality to frozen B.
submissions.required: independent quality gate and fixed .8/.2 variant; if no gain skip slot
submissions.prediction: public_MRR25 delta versus fixed B recorded separately from independent effect

submissions.claim: Adaptive route retains quality at reduced measured cost.
submissions.required: independent efficiency gate, same-device latency, all source and runtime checks
submissions.prediction: noninferiority on public score plus external latency evidence; no causal speed claim from public score

submissions.claim: One preregistered specialist improves the final end-to-end identification pipeline.
submissions.required: choose finalist on DEV, then one independent confirmation; approved offline assets and full rerun
submissions.prediction: artifact and expected direction frozen before slot; uncertainty included

calendar.work: Historical baseline/score evidence archived; no retrospective new experiment claim.
HX00 exposure/metadata repair plan; fixed ensemble rejection recorded; student diagnostic queued; historical Colab prepared.
Complete HX00 and matched baseline; collect HX01 OOF teachers and Colab student run if runtime available.
HX01 and HX02 clean DEV + stress diagnostics; lock one student artifact; no weights grid.
Independent HX01 confirmation on reserved panel A; same-device latency; S-A only if efficiency gate passes.
HX02 error complementarity and locked confirmation on distinct panel B; HX05 metadata/ingestion on Colab.
S-B if quality gate passed; train/calibrate HX03 on development data; optional fixed CNN arm if resources allow.
Lock router; evaluate end-to-end on fresh panel C; run HX05 baseline and LLM when adapters/checkpoints ready.
HX03 stress and latency repeats; HX04 or HX06 development choice, source/exposure audit; freeze one specialist.
S-C if efficiency gate passed; one specialist confirmation on reserved panel D; report CASMI22 historical comparison separately.
Offline full 400-query reruns; identical output and metric keys across Colab/Kaggle, memory/runtime/fallback checks; assemble factorial attribution.
S-D if frozen specialist passes; final evidence report including failed/inconclusive experiments. Preserve two final candidates for final deadline.

stop_rules: If HX00 not passed, all model scores remain exploratory and confirmation/submission claim blocked.
If Colab unavailable record pending, do not relabel prepared as running; reschedule within remaining dates without collapsing validation.
No fresh identities after exposure: used confirmation cannot be renamed fresh.
If precision inadequate report inconclusive; do not widen margins after result.
A rejected extra objective does not justify a grid of leaderboard weights.
Retrospective CASMI22 improvement does not prove superiority to all participants or predict CASMI26 private score.

resource_budgets.preferred_training: Colab T4; record actual account/runtime availability, never presume quota renewal
resource_budgets.budget_semantics: At most 240 allocated minutes across arms; caps are ceilings, not additive reservations. Queue checks and CPU evaluations do not imply GPU use. Extend only if a preregistered useful arm needs it, with a new allocation record.
resource_budgets.concurrency: Coordinate bus; at most two development GPU runs simultaneously, one model choice per experiment family before confirmation. Respect provider quotas.
resource_budgets.Kaggle: Short compatibility and official offline reruns; historical GPU validation on Colab.
